A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

, for the VIRGO configuration, the sensitivity to the stochastic and isotropic background of pre-big-bang gravitons is not significantly improved by the addition of a second detector, but the achievable sensitivities could be improved by a factor of about 2 by a reduction of the thermal noise.
the VIRGO pair is expected to be sensitive enough to probe the whole range of pre-big-bang scenarios, including those with a non-minimal string cosmology.

the sensitivity of the VIRGO detectors to the stochastic gravitational wave backgrounds is expected to be limited by the thermal noise.
